args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That label is out of date and should read Pellow Home Living.
- Ask: please check the saved report and update the label so it matches the new account name.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti (with Bettina Kroll)

args.text:
@Bettina Kroll, I saved a mail draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It's a draft only, so nothing has been sent.

It contains Sofia's bullets plus your two lines: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. The draft is signed "Sofia Marchetti (with Bettina Kroll)", so change the sign-off if you'd rather it come from you alone.
